cv.name: Yanis Khelifi
cv.headline: Senior Data Analyst | Product & Pricing Analytics | SQL, Python, dbt
cv.summary: Data analyst with ten years across retail, mobility, freelance consulting and a fintech scale-up. Has moved between product analytics, pricing and BI rather than up a single ladder, and enjoys turning messy data into decisions.

experience.title: Senior Data Analyst – Pricing
bullets: Own pricing analytics for merchant fees; built the elasticity model behind the 2025 price grid
Model data in dbt on BigQuery and publish self-serve dashboards in Looker
Price change based on my analysis raised gross margin by 1.8 points without higher churn
Work with product managers on A/B test design and readouts

experience.title: Freelance Data Analyst
bullets: Missions for four clients (e-commerce, a museum, two start-ups): KPI frameworks and dashboards
Set up a Metabase stack for a 30-person start-up

experience.title: Product Analyst
bullets: Analysed ride data for scooter rebalancing; left after the company's French operations closed

experience.title: BI Analyst
bullets: Built weekly sales reporting for 120 stores in Power BI
Automated the store stock report with SQL Server and SSIS

skills: SQL (BigQuery, PostgreSQL, SQL Server), Python (pandas, statsmodels)
A/B testing, price elasticity, cohort analysis
projects: Open-source dbt package for French public holiday calendars
